author: N.G Martin, Hugo

steps.title: Homogenize liver tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize liver tissue in PBS on ice using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 300 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells and count nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ATAC lysis buffer (Active Motif, catalog 105310), count nuclei, and aliquot 5 × 10⁴ nuclei per reaction.

steps.title: Perform tagmentation
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Tagmentation Master Mix to each reaction and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes in a Thermoshaker (Life Technologies).

steps.title: Purify DNA post‑tagmentation
steps.instruction: Transfer reactions to new tubes, add 250 µL DNA Purification Binding Buffer and 5 µL 3 M sodium acetate (no pH adjustment), then purify DNA using the kit’s purification columns.

steps.title: Quantify purified DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: PCR amplify library
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries by PCR amplification using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Clean up amplified library
steps.instruction: Perform DNA clean‑up with SPRI beads at 1.2 × the sample volume (beads provided in the kit).

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate library quality and quantity on an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq targeting ~50 million 150‑bp paired‑end reads per library.
